title: The Pokémon That Reveals Three Forms in One Battle
premise: Terapagos reveals deeper forms as battle escalates, ending in its massive Stellar Form.
audiencePromise: Reveal Normal, Terastal, and Stellar Form in sequence, then land on Terapagos's final battlefield-changing ability.
openLoop: How many forms can Pokémon #1024 reveal in one battle?
payoff: Stellar Form activates Teraform Zero, removing active weather and terrain.
engagementQuestion: Which Terapagos form has the best reveal?

voice.instructions: Curious, cinematic Pokémon short narrator. Begin with mystery, build with each form reveal, then land the Stellar Form payoff with wonder. Keep it energetic, crisp, and conversational. Never imitate a known person or character.

scenes.headline: ONE POKÉMON. THREE FORMS.
scenes.narration: This Pokémon reveals a second form, then a third.
scenes.caption: NORMAL → TERASTAL → STELLAR

scenes.headline: IT STARTS SMALL
scenes.narration: Terapagos begins in a small Normal Form outside battle.
scenes.caption: NORMAL FORM

scenes.headline: BATTLE CHANGES EVERYTHING
scenes.narration: Enter battle, and Tera Shift turns it into Terastal Form.
scenes.caption: NORMAL → TERASTAL

scenes.headline: EIGHTEEN TYPES
scenes.narration: Its Terastal shell carries symbols representing all eighteen Pokémon types.
scenes.caption: 18 TYPES ON ONE SHELL

scenes.headline: THEN IT GOES STELLAR
scenes.narration: Terastallize it, and Terapagos unlocks its massive Stellar Form.
scenes.caption: TERASTAL → STELLAR

scenes.headline: WHICH FORM WINS?
scenes.narration: Three forms, one Pokémon. Which Terapagos design wins?
scenes.caption: NORMAL • TERASTAL • STELLAR
